title: Split runtime provider config mappings and runtime tests by capability/lifecycle
description: After web/core/pipeline first-pass splits, split runtime provider config DTO/mapping logic and runtime tests into focused capability and lifecycle modules.

files.change: Split chat, STT, TTS, embedding, and rerank runtime config mapping into capability modules.
Group runtime tests by config IO, lifecycle/restart, provider config, platform webchat, and policy behavior.

criteria: Provider config re-exports remain compatible from astrbot_runtime.
Runtime tests are grouped by behavior area and still cover current cases.
No provider/platform parity behavior is added.
